goal: Implement native LLM profile management and secure-key storage foundation across settings, core LLM contracts, and Room-backed profile persistence.
non_goals: Do not call real LLM providers from automated tests or device smoke.
Do not implement streaming chat generation; that belongs to NATIVE-P2-005 and later background tasks.
Do not export API key material by default.
Do not import secret values from legacy exports unless a future PRD explicitly approves a secure key import flow.
Do not store API keys as plain Room or DataStore strings.
Do not build signed or release APKs.
Do not modify existing mobile/ Capacitor/PWA release packaging.
Do not touch signing files, alias reverse-tutor, or existing applicationId com.reversetutor.app.
Do not mark native replacement readiness.
acceptance_criteria: A native LLM profile domain model supports provider name/type, base URL, model name, enabled state, capability flags, and secret references without storing raw keys in Room/DataStore.
Provider presets exist for common OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic-compatible, and custom/local-compatible profile creation.
Profile validation rejects blank names/models, malformed base URLs where required, missing provider types, and raw secret material in exportable/profile metadata.
Users can create, list, switch/enable, rename/update, and delete LLM profiles through a Room-backed repository.
A secure-key storage abstraction exists with an Android Keystore-backed implementation path and a deterministic fake for tests.
Saving or updating a profile stores API key material only through the secret store and persists only a secretRef in Room.
Deleting a profile deletes the associated secret reference when one exists.
Connection test behavior runs through a mock/provider abstraction and never calls real providers in automated tests.
Profile export/redaction foundation excludes or redacts key material by default.
Settings UI exposes an LLM profile management foundation with provider presets, profile list, active profile selection, delete confirmation, redacted key status, and mock connection result.
Automated tests cover profile validation, profile CRUD/switch/delete, secret store side effects, redacted export behavior, and mock connection diagnostics.
Connected Room instrumentation covers LLM profile insert/list/delete or equivalent DAO behavior.
Legacy coverage registry is updated conservatively for LEG-026, LEG-027, LEG-028, and LEG-031.
verification_expectations: Follow TDD: add failing tests before production implementation for validation, profile repository, secret-store behavior, redacted export, mock connection diagnostics, and settings UI model.
Run focused core llm, core data, feature settings, and app JVM tests.
Run connected core data instrumentation if an ADB device is available.
Run native project test, lint, and app assembleDebug.
Install preview debug APK on the connected device and capture settings/profile smoke evidence when feasible.
Use app pid/package-specific logcat filtering to avoid global AndroidRuntime false positives.
Validate ADworkflo JSON artifacts with ConvertFrom-Json and rebuild codegraph.
notes: Existing PRD/ARCH/TODO and prior user approval are the design basis for this task.
Existing LlmProfileEntity has secretRef; prefer using it instead of changing schema version unless implementation proves a migration is necessary.
This task creates configuration and safety foundation only; live provider generation belongs to NATIVE-P2-005.
